title: Anthropic Reports $80.7 Billion Loss in First Half of 2026
excerpt: Anthropic recorded a net loss of $80.7 billion during the first six months of 2026, significantly higher than its previous losses.
body_html:
Artificial intelligence company Anthropic recorded a net loss of $80.7 billion during the first six months of 2026.

This financial result marks a sharply wider loss compared to the company's previous figures of $13 billion.
